GHSA-3c67-gc48-983w.details: An archive traversal flaw was found in all ansible-engine versions 2.9.x prior to 2.9.7, when running `ansible-galaxy collection` install. When extracting a collection .tar.gz file, the directory is created without sanitizing the filename. An attacker could take advantage to overwrite any file within the system.
